decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost addition to the established floor-care range that the firm has publicly offered, and its modest results can still be attributed to the short time since launch, so management persists with it.

With the maintenance oil already withdrawn, the multi-model care line becomes the firm's main justification for its oiled-floor care commitment, so sunk investment and strategic fit argue for keeping it.
After the moisture-protection underlay was dropped, the high-density foam is the remaining underlay in the accessory system, and reversing a second underlay decision would be hard to justify.
The oak parquet line is central to the firm's core business, production investment and announced direction, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
